lastCompletedStory.title: Pure backlog list-view derivation in src/issues/list.ts

nextStoryContext: deriveBacklogView(backlog, options?) is exported from src/issues/list.ts. Shape for US-002 (runIssueList) to consume: returns BacklogViewGroup[] = { stage: IssueStage; entries: BacklogViewEntry[] }[], where BacklogViewEntry = { issue: IssueEntry; unmetBlockers: string[] }. Groups are ALWAYS present for the 3 default lifecycle stages (idea, specified, planned) in that order, even when a group has zero entries -- the renderer decides whether to skip empty stage headings, deriveBacklogView does not. BacklogViewOptions = { includeShipped?: boolean }; when true a 4th group with stage:'shipped' is appended (abandoned issues are still excluded from it). unmetBlockers is the ready-to-render list of blocker ids for the '[blocked: X]' marker (already filtered to isBlocked-semantics: present in backlog AND stage !== 'shipped'; a missing/unknown blockedBy id is silently omitted, mirroring isBlocked). Sort within each group mirrors selectPlannableIssue: ranked-before-unranked, ascending rank, numeric-id-suffix tie-break -- reimplemented locally in list.ts (not imported from select.ts) per the story's isolation note. Rank field doubles as 'priority' for the rendered priority column per US-002 AC2.
